newsitem.title: USA: INCSTAR in definitive pact to be acquired.
newsitem.headline: INCSTAR in definitive pact to be acquired.

text.p: INCSTAR Corp, a medical immunodiagnostics company, said Monday it signed a definitive agreement to be acquired by American Standard Inc, a wholly owned unit of American Standard Cos Inc for $6.32 per share in cash.
The companies reached a memorandum of understanding on January 24 on the merger.

The merger, which has been approved by a special committee of independent directors and the board of INCSTAR, requires approval by a majority shareholder vote, satisfaction of customary closing conditions and regulatory approvals.
It also is subject to the completion by American Standard of its agreement to acquire the European medical diagnostics business of Sorin Biomedica S.p.A., a large stakeholder in INCSTAR.
